findings.description: ToolTabBar's handleMusicPress fires onMusic?.() with no data payload. If a user selects an audio file, the parent component has no way to know which file was selected. Either provide the file URI in the onMusic callback or implement a separate callback channel for selected files.

StickerButton in ToolTabBar Visual tab is instantiated with onPress={() => {}} (no-op). If clicking the button should open a sticker picker, implement the handler or ensure StickerButton internally manages picker logic and invokes onStickerSelect.

The playhead glow shadow uses shadowOpacity: 0.6 and shadowRadius: 4, which is subtle on mobile devices. Consider increasing shadow opacity to 0.8+ or adding a semi-transparent orange rectangle behind the playhead line for stronger visual emphasis.

findings.issue: Active button background contrast may be insufficient
findings.description: ToolButton active state applies rgba(255, 107, 53, 0.2) background on dark surface (#0A0A0A). This 20% opacity tint results in very subtle visual distinction. Verify that the active state contrast meets at least 3:1 for UI components, or increase opacity to 0.35+ for better accessibility.
